```
// caves-checkpoint 冻结基线再生（自冻结段）。默认 skip；SW_FREEZE_CAVES=1 触发写入。
//
// 策略（2026-08-13 自制机制修复批定型）：
//   - 逐条对比现 JS 链哈希与 golden：一致（✓）→ 原样保留（含 oracle 权威段
//     terrain→surfacecaves/desertentrance 与任何未漂移条目）；
//   - 不一致 → 用现 JS 哈希刷新该行（自冻结段语义）；
//   - **例外：corruption 恒保留 golden 行**（oracle 已转录段，承载跨实现权威；
//     本批起其上游网格已合法漂移 → 该行将持续 ✗，属"待 oracle 扩展转录"备案项，
//     与 SandboxWorld/LiquidSim 遗留红同模式，勿用本工具覆盖它）；
//   - golden 里存在但本链不产出的行（dirtlayer/rocklayer）原样保留。
//
// 用法：SW_FREEZE_CAVES=1 npx vitest run tests/_freeze-caves.test.ts
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import { readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import { chainCheckpoints } from './caves-checkpoint.test';

const FREEZE = !!process.env.SW_FREEZE_CAVES;
const CASES = [
  { file: 'caves-chain-9293480.json', seedText: '9293480', evil: 0 as const },
  { file: 'caves-chain-SandboxWorld.json', seedText: 'SandboxWorld', evil: 1 as const },
];
/** oracle 转录段：恒以 golden 为准（刷新禁入） */
const ORACLE_AUTHORITY = new Set(['corruption']);

describe('caves-checkpoint 冻结基线再生', () => {
  for (const c of CASES) {
    it(`种子 ${c.seedText}${FREEZE ? '：重冻结自冻结段' : '（dry-run：仅报告差异行数）'}`, () => {
      const path = fileURLToPath(new URL(`./golden/${c.file}`, import.meta.url));
      const golden = JSON.parse(readFileSync(path, 'utf8')) as { checkpoints: string[] };
      const gold = new Map<string, string>();
      for (const line of golden.checkpoints) {
        const sp = line.split(/[| ]+/);
        gold.set(sp[0], `${sp[1]} ${sp[2]} ${sp[4]}`);   // typ act liq（wal=sp[3] 不比）
      }
      const res = chainCheckpoints(c.seedText, c.evil);
      const next: string[] = [];
      let refreshed = 0, kept = 0;
      for (const line of golden.checkpoints) {
        const name = line.split(/[| ]+/)[0];
        const g = res.grids.get(name);
        if (!g) { next.push(line); continue; }            // 本链不产出（dirtlayer 等）
        const ours = g;                                    // "typ act liq"
        const wall = res.walls.get(name) ?? line.split(/[| ]+/)[3];
        if (ours === gold.get(name) || ORACLE_AUTHORITY.has(name)) {
          next.push(line); kept++;
        } else {
          const [typ, act, liq] = ours.split(' ');
          next.push(`${name}|${typ} ${act} ${wall} ${liq}`);
          refreshed++;
        }
      }
      if (FREEZE) {
        writeFileSync(path, JSON.stringify({ ...golden, checkpoints: next }, null, 2) + '\n');
      }
      console.log(`[freeze] ${c.file}: kept=${kept} refreshed=${refreshed} (corruption 恒保留 oracle 行)`);
      expect(refreshed + kept).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    });
  }
});

```

```
import { runJunglePass } from '../src/world/gen/vanilla/JunglePass';
import { runMudCavesPass } from '../src/world/gen/vanilla/Spread';
import { runDesertMoundOnly, runDesertEntrancesAndHive } from '../src/world/gen/vanilla/DesertPass';
import { runMushroomPass } from '../src/world/gen/vanilla/MushroomPass';
import { runMarblePass, runGranitePass } from '../src/world/gen/vanilla/MarbleGranitePass';
import { runFloatingIslandsPass } from '../src/world/gen/vanilla/StructuresPass';
import { runDirtToMudPass, runSiltPass } from '../src/world/gen/vanilla/DirtToMudPass';
import { runShiniesPass } from '../src/world/gen/vanilla/ShiniesPass';
import { runWebsPass } from '../src/world/gen/vanilla/WebsPass';
import { runUnderworldPass } from '../src/world/gen/vanilla/UnderworldPass';
import { runLakesPass } from '../src/world/gen/vanilla/LakesPass';
import { runSlushPass } from '../src/world/gen/vanilla/IceBiomePass';
import { runCorruptionPass } from '../src/world/gen/vanilla/CorruptionPass';
import { runDungeonPass } from '../src/world/gen/vanilla/DungeonPass';
import { TILE_BY_KEY } from '../src/data/tiles';
import { TILE_DEFS } from '../src/data/tiles';
import { fnv1a } from './pass-hash.test';

const V_ID = new Int32Array(TILE_DEFS.length).fill(-1);
for (let i = 0; i < TILE_DEFS.length; i++) {
  const sheet = TILE_DEFS[i]?.vanilla?.sheet;
  if (typeof sheet === 'number') V_ID[i] = sheet;
}

function hashGrids(st: { type: Uint16Array; flags: Uint8Array; liquid: Uint8Array; wall: Uint16Array; w: number; h: number }) {
  const n = st.w * st.h;
  const mapped = new Uint16Array(n);
  const ghost = new Uint16Array(n);
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const v = V_ID[st.type[i]];
    if (st.flags[i]) mapped[i] = v < 0 ? 0x7fff : v;
    else ghost[i] = v < 0 ? 0x7fff : v; // 幽灵 parity：inactive 格的残留 type
  }
  return `${fnv1a(mapped)} ${fnv1a(st.flags)} ${fnv1a(st.liquid)}`;
}

/** wall 单独哈希——只对沙漠段启用：此前 pass 的 JS 墙与 oracle 有既知偏差
 *  （Terrain 自加渲染墙），到 desertmound 为止 wall 不具裁决力；沙漠 Sub-B/C
 *  以墙(187/216)为核心输出，从这里开始逐哈希比对。 */
function hashWalls(st: { wall: Uint16Array }): string {
  return fnv1a(st.wall);
}

function hashGhost(st: { type: Uint16Array; flags: Uint8Array; w: number; h: number }): string {
  const n = st.w * st.h;
  const ghost = new Uint16Array(n);
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    if (st.flags[i]) continue;
    const v = V_ID[st.type[i]];
    ghost[i] = v < 0 ? 0x7fff : v;
  }
  return fnv1a(ghost);   // fnv1a 返回 hex string（注解曾是 number——陈旧签名残留）
}

/** 导出给 tests/_freeze-caves.test.ts（SW_FREEZE_CAVES=1 冻结基线再生用） */
export function chainCheckpoints(seedText: string, evil: 0 | 1) {
  const { world, rng, gs } = runResetAndTerrain({ width: 4200, height: 1200, seedText, evil });
  const st = world.store;
  const out = new Map<string, string>();
  const outWall = new Map<string, string>();
  const snap = (name: string) => { out.set(name, hashGrids(st)); outWall.set(name, hashWalls(st)); };
  out.set('terrain', hashGrids(st));
  runDunesPass(st, rng, gs); out.set('dunes', hashGrids(st));
  runOceanSandPass(st, rng, gs); out.set('oceansand', hashGrids(st));
  runSandPatchesPass(st, rng, gs); out.set('sandpatches', hashGrids(st));
  runTunnelsPass(st, rng, gs); out.set('tunnels', hashGrids(st));
  runMountCavesPass(st, rng, gs); out.set('mountaincaves', hashGrids(st));
  runDirtWallBgPass(st, rng, gs); out.set('dirtwallbg', hashGrids(st));
  runRocksAndClayPass(st, rng, gs); out.set('rocksclay', hashGrids(st));
  runSmallHolesPass(st, rng, gs); out.set('smallholes', hashGrids(st));
  runCavesPass(st, rng, gs); out.set('surfacecaves', hashGrids(st));
  // 1456 注册序（执行序=注册序，WorldGenerator.cs:447）：
  //   14 SurfaceCaves → 16 IceBiome → 17 Grass → Jungle(12497) → 18 MudCaves →
  //   19 Desert → … → 32 Dungeon → 33 MCOpenings → 34 Beaches → 35 Gems。
  //   mcopenings/beaches 原紧跟 surfacecaves（注册序修正移到 Dungeon 后）。
  runIceBiomePass(st, rng, gs); out.set('icebiome', hashGrids(st));
  runGrassPass(st, rng, gs); out.set('grass', hashGrids(st));
  runJunglePass(st, rng, gs); out.set('jungle', hashGrids(st));
  runMudCavesPass(st, TILE_BY_KEY['mud']!, TILE_BY_KEY['v_60_jungle_grass_block']!);
  out.set('mudcaves', hashGrids(st));
  const desc = runDesertMoundOnly(st, rng, gs); out.set('desertmound', hashGrids(st));
  // Sub-C 入口 + Sub-B 蜂巢（DesertBiome.Place 顺序：入口先于 Hive）。
  // afterEntrance 钩子对齐 oracle 的 desertentrance 检查点位（入口后、Hive 前）
  runDesertEntrancesAndHive(st, rng, gs, desc, () => snap('desertentrance'));
  snap('deserthive');        // AddTileVariance 完
  snap('desertdone');        // CleanupArea 仅帧号——状态同 deserthive
  // #20-26（1456 注册序 12581/12800/12884/12976/13172/13192/13233）
  runMushroomPass(st, rng, gs); snap('mushroom');
  runMarblePass(st, rng, gs); snap('marble');
  runGranitePass(st, rng, gs); snap('granite');
  runFloatingIslandsPass(st, rng, gs); snap('islands');
  runDirtToMudPass(st, rng, gs); snap('dirttomud');
  runSiltPass(st, rng, gs); snap('silt');
  runShiniesPass(st, rng, gs); snap('ores');
  // #27/28/30/31（1456 注册序 13659/13697/14613/14756）。
  // #29 Corruption、#32 Dungeon oracle 尚未转录——其 JS 实现仍在 vanillaBiomes 内
  // （位置正确），转录后将插在 lakes 前与 slush 后。
  runWebsPass(st, rng, gs); snap('webs');
  runUnderworldPass(st, rng, gs); snap('underworld');
  // #29 Corruption（cs:13919，oracle 已转录；#32 Dungeon 未转录——其 JS 实现仍在
  // vanillaBiomes 内位置正确，转录后插 lakes 前与 slush 后之间）
  runCorruptionPass(st, rng, gs);

```
```
Interesting! The oracle's granite CA already has the sparse-write+swap. But there's a key difference:

**Oracle**: `tPres[a,b] = 0.0; tRes[a,b] = gRes[a,b]; tAct[a,b] = false;` — the target init copies gRes into tRes and false into tAct, but 0.0 for tPres. The comment says "target 初始化为 source 的**同值拷贝**" — but it actually only copies res, not pres/act.

**JS**: `tPres0/tRes0/tAct0` are all zero-filled. Then `pres`, `res`, `mact` are used as source in round 0. Note in JS, `res` starts as built (solid?4:1), `pres` all 0, `mact` all 0.

Wait, JS: `let pres = new Float64Array(200*200)` (all 0), `let res = ...` all 0 then filled with solid?4:1, `let mact = new Uint8Array(200*200)` all 0.

So in JS, round 0: mact is all zero → the inner loop `if (!mact[ji]) continue;` skips everything! Except center: `if (it < 2) { tPres[100*200+100]=25; tRes[...] = 0; tAct[...] = 1; }`. So after round 0, tAct center=true, tPres center=25, tRes center=0. Then swap. Round 1: mact(center)=true, so center is processed: it computes neighbors' flow (tPres[ni]=pres[ni] i.e. 0, tRes[ni]=res[ni], tAct[ni]=1). Then `it<2` again → center re-set. Then swap.

Oracle round 0: gAct all false → skip all; then `if (it<2)` sets tPres[100,100]=25, tRes[100,100]=0, tAct=true. Swap. Same as JS!

Hmm, so the ONLY difference between oracle and JS init: the oracle sets `tRes[a,b] = gRes[a,b]` at target init. This matters! Because tRes is the "target res" array, which after swap becomes gRes. If tRes[a,b] = gRes[a,b] initially for all cells, then after the first swap, gRes is unchanged (all cells have their original values). In JS, tRes0 is all zeros, so after first swap gRes becomes ALL ZEROS!

Whoa. That's a huge difference. Let me check the vanilla source to see what's correct.

Let me look at GraniteBiome.cs and Magma.cs in the decompiled source.
```

```
class FR
{
    static ulong FrNextSeed(ulong s) => (s * 25214903917UL + 11UL) & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFUL;
    public ulong S;
    public FR(ulong s) { S = s; }
    public FR Mod(ulong m) => new FR(FrNextSeed(m) ^ S);                       // WithModifier(ulong)
    public FR ModXY(int x, int y) => Mod((ulong)(x + 2654435769u + ((long)y << 6)) + ((ulong)y >> 2)); // WithModifier(int,int)
    int Bits(int bits) { S = FrNextSeed(S); return (int)(S >> (48 - bits)); }   // NextBits
    public int Next(int max)
    {
        if ((max & -max) == max) return (int)((long)max * (long)Bits(31) >> 31);
        int num, r2;
        do { num = Bits(31); r2 = num % max; } while (num - r2 + (max - 1) < 0);
        return r2;
    }
    public double NextDouble() => (float)Bits(32) * 4.656613E-10f;
}
```

```
/** Beaches:挖海盆灌水(cs:14958-15120)。

 *  带/深度曲线全偏) */
export function runBeachesPass(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState): void {
  const w = st.w;
  const oceanWaterMin = 220, oceanWaterMax = 260, forcedJungleLen = 275, minSand = 50;
  const edgeWall = 30;

  let floridaL = false, floridaR = false;
  if (rng.next() < 0.25) {
    if (rng.next() < 0.5) floridaL = true; else floridaR = true;
  }

  for (let side = 0; side < 2; side++) {
    if (side === 0) {
      // 左海盆:从 beachLeftEnd-50 之左往世界缘挖
      let waterX = rng.int(oceanWaterMin, oceanWaterMax - 1);  // 原版 Next(220,260) 上界开
      if (gs.dungeonSide === 1) waterX = forcedJungleLen; // 丛林侧强制 275(缩放)
      const cap = gs.beachLeftEnd - minSand;
      if (waterX > cap) waterX = Math.max(2, cap);
      // 该列地表
      let surfY = 0;
      while (!st.flags[st.idx(waterX - 1, surfY)]) surfY++;
      gs.shellStartYLeft = surfY; // cs:14996：ShellPiles 锚点 Y（waterY 调整前的地表值）
      const waterY = surfY + rng.int(1, 4);
      let count = 0, depth = 1;
      for (let x = waterX - 1; x >= 0; x--) {
        if (x > edgeWall) { count++; depth = tuneOceanDepth(rng, count, depth, floridaL); }
        else depth += 1;
        const pad = rng.int(15, 19);
        // cs:15009:(double)k < j + num6 + num9 —— 纯 double 比较,depth 累积小数
        // 部分几乎恒 >0 → 每列多挖一行(曾 Math.trunc 截断,海盆底每列浅一格)
        for (let y = 0; y < waterY + depth + pad && y < st.h; y++) {
          const i = st.idx(x, y);
          if (y < waterY + depth * 0.75 - 3) {
            // 原版仅 active(false)（cs:15014）——保留 type 幽灵（曾清零，
            // 与 oracle 天空/海盆幽灵分叉 6383 格）
            st.flags[i] = 0;
            if (y > waterY) { st.liquid[i] = 255; st.liquidType[i] = 1; }
            else if (y === waterY) {
              st.liquid[i] = 127; st.liquidType[i] = 1;
              // cs:15025-15027：首个到达水线分支的列 = ShellPiles 锚点 X（仅首次）
              if (gs.shellStartXLeft === 0) gs.shellStartXLeft = x;
            }
          } else if (y > waterY) {
            st.type[i] = T.SAND; st.flags[i] = 1;
          }
          st.wall[i] = 0;
        }
      }
    } else {
      // 右海盆:镜像
      let waterX = w - rng.int(oceanWaterMin, oceanWaterMax - 1);  // 上界开,同原版 Next
      if (gs.dungeonSide === -1) waterX = w - forcedJungleLen;
      const cap = gs.beachRightStart + minSand;
      if (waterX < cap) waterX = Math.min(w - 2, cap);
      let surfY = 0;
      while (!st.flags[st.idx(waterX, surfY)]) surfY++;
      gs.shellStartXRight = 0;            // cs:15060：显式清零（左值不串扰，1:1）
      gs.shellStartYRight = surfY;        // cs:15061
      const waterY = surfY + rng.int(1, 4);
      let count = 0, depth = 1;
      for (let x = waterX; x < w; x++) {
        if (x < w - edgeWall) { count++; depth = tuneOceanDepth(rng, count, depth, floridaR); }
        else depth += 1;
        const pad = rng.int(15, 19);
        // cs:15069:(double)k < l + num11 + num9 —— 同左侧纯 double 比较(勿截断)
        for (let y = 0; y < waterY + depth + pad && y < st.h; y++) {
          const i = st.idx(x, y);
          if (y < waterY + depth * 0.75 - 3) {
            // 原版仅 active(false)（cs:15014）——保留 type 幽灵（曾清零，
            // 与 oracle 天空/海盆幽灵分叉 6383 格）
            st.flags[i] = 0;
            if (y > waterY) { st.liquid[i] = 255; st.liquidType[i] = 1; }
            else if (y === waterY) {
              st.liquid[i] = 127; st.liquidType[i] = 1;
              // cs:15090-15092：首个到达水线分支的列 = ShellPiles 锚点 X（仅首次）
              if (gs.shellStartXRight === 0) gs.shellStartXRight = x;
            }
          } else if (y > waterY) {

          }
          st.wall[i] = 0;
        }
      }
    }
  }
```

```
257:  function prot(x: number, y: number, list: DRoom[]): number {
  //   ProtectionType.None。即原版 Legacy 地牢对走廊/挖空 **无任何房间保护**（TilesAndWalls

  function prot(x: number, y: number, list: DRoom[]): number {
    let p = 0;
    for (const rm of list) {
      const q: number = rm.outer.contains(x, y) ? 2 : 0;
      if (q === 1) p = p === 2 ? 3 : 1;
      else if (q === 2) p = p === 1 ? 3 : 2;
      if (p === 3) break;
    }

    return rooms.filter((rm) =>
      rm.outer.containsF(Math.trunc(sx), Math.trunc(sy), fluff)
      || rm.outer.containsF(Math.trunc(mx), Math.trunc(my), fluff)
      || rm.outer.containsF(Math.trunc(ex), Math.trunc(ey), fluff));

    st.flags[i] = 1; st.type[i] = t;

  function chWall(i: number, wl: number, reset: boolean): void {
    if (reset) {
      st.type[i] = 0; st.wall[i] = 0; st.liquid[i] = 0; st.liquidType[i] = 0; st.flags[i] = 0;
    }
    st.wall[i] = wl;
```

```
class DBnd {
  L = 10; R = 10; T = 10; B = 10;
  has = false;
  constructor(public w: number, public h: number) {}
  private cx(v: number): number { return Math.max(10, Math.min(this.w - 10, v)); }
  private cy(v: number): number { return Math.max(10, Math.min(this.h - 10, v)); }
  set(l: number, t: number, r: number, b: number): void {
    this.L = this.cx(l); this.R = this.cx(r); this.T = this.cy(t); this.B = this.cy(b);
    this.calc();
  }
  calc(): void {
    if (this.R <= this.L) this.R = this.L + 1;
    if (this.B <= this.T) this.B = this.T + 1;
    this.has = true;
  }
  upd(x: number, y: number): void;
  upd(minX: number, minY: number, maxX: number, maxY: number): void;
  upd(a: number, b: number, c?: number, d?: number): void {
    if (c === undefined || d === undefined) {
      if (a < this.L) this.L = this.cx(a);
      if (a > this.R) this.R = this.cx(a);
      if (b < this.T) this.T = this.cy(b);
      if (b > this.B) this.B = this.cy(b);
    } else {
      if (a < this.L) this.L = this.cx(a);
      if (c > this.R) this.R = this.cx(c);
      if (b < this.T) this.T = this.cy(b);
      if (d > this.B) this.B = this.cy(d);
    }
    this.has = true;
  }

sealed class DBnd
{
    public int L = 10, R = 10, T = 10, B = 10;
    public bool Has;
    static int Cx(int v) => Math.Clamp(v, 10, 4200 - 10);
    static int Cy(int v) => Math.Clamp(v, 10, 1200 - 10);
    public void Set(int l, int t, int rr, int b) { L = Cx(l); R = Cx(rr); T = Cy(t); B = Cy(b); Calc(); }
    public void Calc() { if (R <= L) R = L + 1; if (B <= T) B = T + 1; Has = true; }
    public void Upd(int x, int y) { if (x < L) L = Cx(x); if (x > R) R = Cx(x); if (y < T) T = Cy(y); if (y > B) B = Cy(y); Has = true; }
    public void Upd(int minX, int minY, int maxX, int maxY)
    { if (minX < L) L = Cx(minX); if (maxX > R) R = Cx(maxX); if (minY < T) T = Cy(minY); if (maxY > B) B = Cy(maxY); Has = true; }
    public void TopSet(int t) { T = Cy(t); Has = true; }
    public void Inflate(int a) => Set(L - a, T - a, R + a, B + a);
    public bool Contains(int x, int y) => Has && x >= L && x < R && y >= T && y < B;
    public bool ContainsF(int x, int y, int fluff) => fluff == 0 ? Contains(x, y) : (Has && x >= L - fluff && x < R + fluff && y >= T - fluff && y < B + fluff);
}
```

```
160:  get vanilla(): UnifiedRandom {
---
export class RNG {
  private ur: UnifiedRandom;
  constructor(seed: number) {
    this.ur = new UnifiedRandom(seed);
  }

  next(): number {
    return this.ur.nextDouble();
  }

  /** 闭区间 [min, max]，≡ 原版 Next(min, max+1) */
  int(min: number, max: number): number {
    return this.ur.nextIntRange(min, max + 1);
  }

  range(min: number, max: number): number {
    return min + this.ur.nextDouble() * (max - min);
  }

  chance(p: number): boolean {
    return this.ur.nextDouble() < p;
  }

  pick<T>(arr: T[]): T {
    return arr[this.ur.nextInt(arr.length)];
  }

```
